description: Fix a session, running or finished: start and end (HH:MM on date; an end before the start means it ran past midnight), task, area, project, lever, step, plan item, summary, outcome, attention share, weight. It is classified again after a change. Use it when a timer was forgotten or a session was labelled wrong.

attention_share.description: share of the session's wall time that was real attention

date.description: local date of start and end; default the session's own date

exclusive.description: true: nothing else was happening then

weight.description: attention weight vs other sessions at the same time, default 1

name: edit_session
title: Edit session
